title: Alia Bhatt Locked for Extended Role in Brahmastra 2 as Ranbir Kapoor Prepares Double Duty as Shiva and Dev
excerpt: The Astraverse sequel is set to begin shooting in April 2027, with Deepika Padukone in talks to play Amrita opposite Ranbir's Dev.
body:
• Alia Bhatt will have an extended appearance in Brahmastra 2, shooting for approximately 25 days of the planned 125-day schedule, according to Bollywood Hungama
  • Ranbir Kapoor is set to play a double role as both Shiva and Dev, with shooting expected to begin in April 2027 after he wraps Ramayana Part 2
  • Deepika Padukone is in talks to play Amrita, Dev's wife, though her casting is not yet confirmed due to scheduling commitments
  • The sequel, directed by Ayan Mukerji, will focus on the origin story of Dev and Amrita, expanding the Astraverse mythology established in the 2022 original

Brahmastra Part Two: Dev is finally taking shape, with Bollywood Hungama reporting that Alia Bhatt has been locked for an extended appearance in the sequel, while Ranbir Kapoor prepares to take on a challenging double role as both Shiva and the titular Dev.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=es1AaIvzExg

The report, published on August 20, comes days after multiple outlets confirmed that Kapoor is set to begin shooting in April 2027, following completion of Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Part 2. Director Ayan Mukerji is reportedly working intensively on the script and is committed to taking the film on floors by that date.

Alia's Extended Role and the Dev-Amrita Story

According to Bollywood Hungama, Alia Bhatt's Isha will feature prominently in the sequel, with the actress expected to shoot for around 25 days. The film itself is planned as an approximately 125-day shoot — significantly longer than many Bollywood productions.

"Bollywood Hungama's source added that Alia will have a "parallel lead along with Deepika Padukone in Brahmastra 3," confirming the trilogy's long-term casting plan."

https://x.com/indiaforums/status/2090356724133978466

The sequel will largely revolve around Dev and Amrita, the characters expected to be played by Ranbir Kapoor and Deepika Padukone. Kapoor's double role means he will appear as both the returning Shiva and the mysterious Dev, whose release from imprisonment was teased in the first film's post-credits scene.

While Alia is paired opposite Shiva, Deepika's Amrita would serve as Dev's wife. Bollywood Hungama's source added that Alia will have a "parallel lead along with Deepika Padukone in Brahmastra 3," confirming the trilogy's long-term casting plan.

Deepika's Casting Still in Talks

Conversations with Deepika Padukone are reportedly still underway, with her packed personal and professional commitments creating scheduling complexities. Pinkvilla had earlier reported that Deepika made an uncredited cameo appearance as Amrita in the first film — a brief sequence that was meant to set up her larger role in the sequel.

According to Zoom TV, Deepika's availability has been a factor, and the team has explored alternative casting possibilities for the role. However, Mukerji and his team believe the character requires "an actor with considerable screen presence and gravitas," making Deepika their first choice.

A Four-Year Journey to Part Two

Brahmastra: Part One — Shiva was released in September 2022, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Amitabh Bachchan alongside cameos from Shah Rukh Khan and Nagarjuna. The film grossed over ₹430 crore worldwide, becoming the highest-grossing Bollywood film of that year despite mixed reactions to its dialogue and screenplay.

The sequel has been in development since, with multiple timeline announcements along the way. In April 2023, Mukerji announced plans to release Brahmastra 2 and 3 in December 2026 and 2027 respectively. In February 2026, Ranbir told fans during a livestream that the sequel would start "very, very soon, sooner than you expect," according to BizAsiaLive.

Producer Namit Malhotra confirmed at CinemaCon 2026 in April that Brahmastra 2 would move forward after Ramayana wraps up, marking one of the clearest production timeline commitments from the team.

What's Next

The Astraverse — the cinematic universe built around Indian mythology — also includes confirmed appearances from Ranveer Singh, Prithviraj Sukumaran, and Anupam Kher as new additions to the cast, according to the film's Wikipedia page. The ensemble also features returning cast members Amitabh Bachchan, Mouni Roy, Shah Rukh Khan, Nagarjuna, and Dimple Kapadia.

With an April 2027 shooting start and a planned December 2026 or later release window, the film remains one of the most anticipated Bollywood projects for diaspora audiences who followed the franchise's ambitious attempt to build an Indian mythology-based cinematic universe.
